description: Prediction market odds: live Polymarket markets on any topic (elections, Fed rate cuts, crypto, sports, AI, geopolitics) with the probability each outcome implies as a percentage, plus volume, liquidity and end date. One market by slug: prediction.market. $0.05 per call.
